name: Apartmenthaus Marina
beschreibung: Apartmenthaus Marina is located in a quiet side street in the Tyrolean municipality of Matrei in Osttirol. Classified as hotel accommodation, it offers both double rooms and apartments with kitchenettes. Amenities include a breakfast room and a lockable storage room for bicycles and skis. The property features direct views of the nearby mountain panorama. Guests use the house as an ideal base for both summer and winter activities. Rooms are simply and practically furnished, and on-site parking is available.
